Q: What is AI?
A: Artificial intelligence is software that performs tasks that typically require human intelligence.
Q: What is a REST API?
A: A REST API exposes resources over HTTP using stateless requests and standard methods.
Q: What is a database index?
A: A database index is a data structure that speeds up reads at the cost of slower writes.
Q: What is a race condition?
A: A race condition occurs when outcomes depend on the unpredictable timing of concurrent operations.
Q: What is garbage collection?
A: Garbage collection reclaims memory that the program can no longer reach.
Q: What is a memory leak?
A: A memory leak happens when allocated memory is never released, growing usage over time.
Q: What is idempotency?
A: An operation is idempotent when repeating it has the same effect as performing it once.
Q: What is a webhook?
A: A webhook is an HTTP callback that sends a payload to a registered URL when an event occurs.
